nodes.label: Hardware Accelerated Enrichments
nodes.rationale: Enrichment acceleration is independent of object detection acceleration and is selected by choosing the matching Frigate image (-rocm, -tensorrt, -tensorrt-jp6, -rk, default for OpenVINO). ROCm disables unstable models on purpose. A Coral is a TPU and accelerates nothing here. tensorrt for detection plus Intel iGPU for enrichments is unsupported.
